text:
anya: Quick thread to lock the tenant-phased safety ladder for billing.checkout.v4. This is a customer-driven launch with enterprise opt-ins; we need a clear per-tenant holdback, admin pause, and automatic fallbacks.
kevin: Agree. Suggest darklaunch + micro-canary in one AZ, then a region-aware ramp. Keep default off for all tenants.
anya: Proposed phases: darklaunch (internal shadow 24h), micro-canary us-west-2 0.5% for 30m, regional warmup us-west-2 + eu-west-1 3% for 4h, staged tenant bands to 20% over 24h, then conditional ramp to 100% over 48h.
marcus: Kill-switch rules: auto-fallback if global error_rate >= 1.75x baseline for 3m OR p95 latency increase > 150ms for 5m. Immediate rollback if any single enterprise tenant loses >0.75% payment_success.
jordan: For A/B gating we need payment_success_rate + checkout_conversion delta. Block passes >20% until 95% CI for primary metric is non-inferior. Will add a CI gate to the pipeline.
lina: Sales asks: platinum customers require early opt-in and a 24h rollback grace window. We'll need a per-tenant admin toggle plus an audit trail email.
kevin: Implementation: use feature-flag service with region and tenant strategies + flag metadata state. Example rule (text): flag=billing.checkout.v4_enabled, strategies=[{region:us-west-2,pct:0.5},{tenant:T-PLAT-900,pct:100}], kill_conditions={err_mult:1.75,p95_ms:150}.
marcus: Ops: request two 90m watch windows on launch day (08:30-10:00 PT, 14:00-15:30 PT). Pager escalation: oncall -> infra lead -> eng-sre. Add runbook link and auto-postmortem hook on rollback.
anya: I'll create runbook RB-2026-777 and list named approvers per window. Auto-disable flag for 12h on automated fallback to avoid hot-retries.
kevin: Fallback policy: route affected traffic to billing.checkout.v3 and mark tenants in the failed cohort with a 24h exclusion. Prevent auto-reenable for at least 12h and require manual approve.
jordan: Also plan a 10-day experiment at 15% on non-critical flows (search & recs) to surface downstream regressions; tag telemetry with experiment_id and cohort.
lina: Add a manual pause button in admin console and an API endpoint for partner ops. Security review required for audit logs.
marcus: Preflight checklist: smoke suite green in shadow, dashboards (p50/p95/p99, error_rate, per-tenant success_rate), alerts mapped to runbook, rollout inhibit if infra CPU >80% or error budget low.
anya: Gate for phase transition: no hard triggers, p95 <=1.2x baseline, no enterprise escalations, CI gate passes.
kevin: Timeline: Day0 darklaunch, Day1 micro-canary then warmup, Day2-3 staged tenant ramp to 20%, Day3-5 full ramp if stable.
anya: Owners: ops owns micro-canary approval; product+eng own banded ramp approvals. Approvers will be in RB-2026-777.
lina: I'll compile platinum CSV and email list by EOD.
jordan: I'll publish the experiment dashboard and implement the CI sample-size gate.
marcus: I'll wire automation to flip flag to fallback on kill conditions and post to #incidents via ops-bot.
ops-bot: Automation note: fallback hooks are ready. Will post state changes and tag oncall when triggered. :gear:
anya: Posting as canonical plan. Target micro-canary Fri 09:00 PT. Ping in-thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
